paragraphs: During tax season, start the morning by meeting clients and collecting documents, then enter income and deductions item by item. Consult regulations or ask a supervisor about ambiguous items. At midday, calculate taxes in batches and produce drafts. In the afternoon, verify identity and amounts with clients and explain deductions. Before leaving, file returns, archive records, and prepare the next day's review list.

In short: match income to the tax code. Duties include collecting documents, entering forms, calculating taxes, finding tax benefits, filing on time, and answering questions. The work combines analysis with execution and stands on the front line of compliant filing.
